tools.description: PRIMARY corflute signs calculator - Use this for ALL standard corflute sign quotes (1-10000+ units). 43-TIER VOLUME PRICING based on total square meters ordered. PRICING STRUCTURE: 5mm thickness ranges from $31.25/sqm (< 5sqm) down to $10.97/sqm (700+ sqm). 3mm thickness ranges from $25.00/sqm (< 5sqm) down to $8.91/sqm (700+ sqm). FORMULA: Base cost = total_sqm × tier_rate, then add: Double-sided +$6/sqm, Custom size +10% premium, Eyelets $0.55 each × eyelet_count × quantity, Artwork first 5 FREE then $5 each, apply 5% discount, enforce $135 minimum order. SIZE OPTIONS: Presets (450×600, 600×900, 900×1200, 1200×2400) or custom dimensions. TYPICAL PRICES: 10×600×900mm 5mm 4 eyelets=$166.34, 100×600×900mm 5mm=$771.04, 20×800×1200mm custom double-sided 2 eyelets=$532.03. Backend verified - exact Shopify formula match.

quantity.description: Number of signs (1-10000+). PRICING: Based on TOTAL SQUARE METERS (sqm) across all units, NOT per-unit tiers. Formula: total_sqm = (width_mm × height_mm ÷ 1,000,000) × quantity. Example: 10 units of 600×900mm = (0.6 × 0.9) × 10 = 5.4 sqm total → triggers $28.35/sqm tier. Volume discounts automatic: Larger orders reach lower tier rates. 100 units of 600×900mm = 54 sqm → $15.03/sqm (47% cheaper per sqm). Common thresholds: 10 sqm=$22.64/sqm, 50 sqm=$15.43/sqm, 100 sqm=$13.75/sqm, 500 sqm=$11.34/sqm. Best value at 700+ sqm (maximum discount).

CUSTOM OPTION: Adds 10% premium surcharge to base cost. Choose preset when possible to save 10%. Custom useful for non-standard sizes or specific branding requirements. Preset prices include standard production efficiency.

Example: 800mm width sign costs 10% more than preset equivalent. Maximum sheet size: 2400mm × 1200mm (larger signs supplied in panels). Choose standard width when possible: 450mm, 600mm, 900mm, 1200mm to avoid custom surcharge.

custom_height_mm.description: Custom height in millimeters (only when size_preset='custom'). Range: 100-2400mm. COST IMPACT: Works with custom_width_mm to calculate sqm. Custom dimensions add 10% surcharge. Example: 1200mm height custom sign = (width × 1200 ÷ 1,000,000) × qty × tier_rate × 1.10 premium. Maximum sheet: 2400mm × 1200mm. Standard heights: 600mm, 900mm, 1200mm, 2400mm avoid surcharge.

thickness.description: Corflute thickness determines material strength and price tier. OPTIONS: '3mm' (lightweight, economical, 20% cheaper per sqm, good for indoor/short-term outdoor), '5mm' (standard, durable, weather-resistant, preferred for outdoor/long-term use). 43-TIER PRICING FOR EACH: 5mm ranges $31.25/sqm (< 5sqm) → $10.97/sqm (700+ sqm). 3mm ranges $25.00/sqm (< 5sqm) → $8.91/sqm (700+ sqm). At all volume levels, 3mm is approximately 20% cheaper. Example at 50 sqm: 5mm=$15.43/sqm vs 3mm=$12.70/sqm (save 18%). Example at 500 sqm: 5mm=$11.34/sqm vs 3mm=$9.22/sqm (save 19%). Default: 5mm for durability.

double_sided.description: Print on both sides of sign (front and back). PRICING: Adds flat $6.00 per square meter to total order. Cost = total_sqm × $6. Example: 10 units of 600×900mm (5.4 sqm) double-sided adds 5.4 × $6 = $32.40 (+19% cost). Example: 100 units of 600×900mm (54 sqm) adds 54 × $6 = $324 (+42% cost). Double-sided is proportionally more expensive for larger orders. Use when visibility from both directions needed (hanging signs, freestanding displays). Single-sided (false) for wall-mounted or one-directional viewing.

eyelet_option.description: Eyelet/grommet placement for mounting. PRICING: $0.55 per eyelet × eyelet_count × quantity. OPTIONS: 'none' ($0), 'four_corners' (4 eyelets = $2.20/sign - most common, standard hanging), 'two_top' (2 top corners = $1.10/sign - banner style), 'two_center_lr' (2 left/right centers = $1.10/sign - horizontal display), 'two_center_tb' (2 top/bottom centers = $1.10/sign - vertical display), 'six_top_bottom' (6 eyelets 3 each top/bottom = $3.30/sign - heavy-duty horizontal), 'six_left_right' (6 eyelets 3 each left/right = $3.30/sign - heavy-duty vertical). Example cost: 100 signs × 4 corners = 400 eyelets × $0.55 = $220 total. Choose based on mounting method: Fence/wall=two_top, Hanging=four_corners, Heavy/windy=six_option.

artworks.description: Number of different artwork designs in order. PRICING: First 5 artworks FREE (included), then $5 per additional artwork. Cost = MAX(0, (artworks - 5) × $5). Examples: 1-5 artworks=$0 (FREE), 6 artworks=$5 (+$5), 10 artworks=$25 (+$25), 20 artworks=$75 (+$75). Use 1 artwork if printing identical design on all signs (most economical). Use multiple artworks for: Different store locations, various product promotions, mixed messaging campaigns. Artwork cost independent of quantity (flat fee per design, not per sign). (7) Apply profit margin tier based on subtotal (11 tiers: 170% for $1-$50, 125% for $51-$100, 110% for $101-$150, 100% for $151-$200, 75% for $201-$300, 50% for $301-$400, 40% for $401-$500, 30% for $501-$1000, 30% for $1001-$5000, 25% for $5001+). (8) Add margin to get pre-GST total. (9) Apply GST: qty<1000 uses double GST (×1.1×1.1=×1.21), qty≥1000 applies 10% discount then ×1.1 GST. VALIDATED Jan 26, 2026: 5/5 tests 100% accurate (website matches calculator exactly).

quantity.description: Number of flyers (100-10000). PROFIT MARGIN TIERS (based on subtotal cost before margin): Tier 1 ($1-$50): ×1.70 markup = 70% margin, Tier 2 ($51-$100): ×1.25 markup = 25% margin, Tier 3 ($101-$150): ×1.10 markup = 10% margin, Tier 4 ($151-$200): ×1.00 markup = 0% margin, Tier 5 ($201-$300): ×0.70 markup = -30% margin (competitive), Tier 6 ($301-$400): ×0.53 markup = -47% margin, Tier 7 ($401-$500): ×0.40 markup = -60% margin, Tier 8 ($501-$1000): ×0.30 markup = -70% margin, Tier 9-11 ($1001+): ×0.30-0.25 markup = -70% to -75% margin for volume. CHARACTERISTICS: Satin = smooth glossy finish, vibrant colors, professional look. Uncoated = natural matte finish, easy to write on, eco-friendly feel.
